notablePrerequisites:
You have a green creature card in hand that can be cast using {G}.
You control a basic Forest.
Nettle Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting Nettle Sentinel.
Cast the green creature card from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Nettle Sentinel triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the green creature, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nettle Sentinel by tapping it, returning the green creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
